context: OpenCode is the initial execution environment, but the Master System must remain usable by other orchestrators, CLIs and automation.
problem: How do we integrate a specific tool without coupling the core system to it?

pros: Tools can be added or replaced

decision: Keep CORE and SCHEMAS tool-independent; place all tool-specific integration in INTEGRATIONS/<tool>/. The reference CLI is one adapter among possible others.
reason: It satisfies the explicit requirement that the system must not be tightly coupled to OpenCode and must remain tool-independent.
consequences: Integration work is isolated. Future tools implement the same command/artifact/gate contracts without changing CORE.
